dog.description_text:
Say hello to Bryce, an adorable little Chihuahua with a heart full of love. With his cute face and charming personality, Bryce is the kind of pup who can melt your heart in an instant. California dreamin' brought him all the way to New York, after being picked up by Animal Control in San Bernadino - and he can't wait to meet you.

If you’re looking for a little companion with a big heart and lots of charm, Bryce just might be your perfect match!
